title: Interior Singularity Structure of Dynamically Formed Black Holes
exact_target: Describe how weak Cauchy-horizon singularities, stronger singularities and the center fit together inside dynamically formed black holes.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30004809 (OWR-8415343-012). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Mathematical Aspects of General Relativity (2021), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2021/40, pp. 2157--2267. Original report and mathematical context.

status_qualification: This is a structural research question. The matter model and regularity notion must be fixed before claiming a theorem for a particular collapse class.
